label: Eject
desc: Blows the canopy and ejects you from your seat - use it when the ship itself is beyond saving.

label: Look behind
desc: Snaps your view to look directly behind your ship without changing your flight direction.

label: Toggle Refuel Operator Mode
desc: Puts your ship into refueling operator mode so you can transfer fuel to another ship docked with you.

label: Next Operator Mode
desc: Cycles between the different operator stations available from your current seat (e.g. refueling, repair).

label: Light Amplification Toggle
desc: Toggles light amplification on your external view, brightening dark environments like unlit interiors or deep space.

label: MFD - Cycle Page - Forwards (Short Press)
desc: Switches the selected multi-function display to its next page.

label: MFD - Cycle Page - Backwards (Short Press)
desc: Switches the selected multi-function display to its previous page.

label:
Docking
(Initiate)
desc: Requests docking clearance and begins the automated docking sequence with a compatible station or ship.

label: Turret Mouse Mode - Cycle Modes
desc: While in a turret, switches how the mouse aims it between relative (FPS-style) and absolute (VJoy) movement.

label: Exit Remote Turret
desc: Leaves the turret and returns you to your seat.

label: Turret Gyro Stabilization (Toggle)
desc: Toggles gyro stabilization on the turret, which smooths your aim against the ship's own movement.

label: Next Remote Turret
desc: Switches control to the next remote turret on the ship.

label: Previous Remote Turret
desc: Switches control to the previous remote turret on the ship.

label: Recenter Turret (Hold)
desc: Holds to snap the turret back to its forward-facing center position.

label: Change Turret Position
desc: Cycles your seated position within a multi-crew turret, on turrets with more than one gunner seat.

label: Headlights (Toggle)
desc: Turns your ship's exterior lights on or off.

label: Launch from Surface
desc: On a surface in zero or low gravity, holds to push off and launch yourself into zero-g movement.

label: Detach from Surface
desc: Releases you from a surface you're currently attached to during zero-g traversal.

label: Roll Left
desc: Rolls your body left while traversing a surface in zero gravity.

label: Roll Right
desc: Rolls your body right while traversing a surface in zero gravity.

label: Self Destruct
desc: Destroys your own ship - hold to arm and trigger it. Only ever needed in specific, rare situations, and it cannot be undone.

label: Flight / Systems Ready
desc: Powers up and readies all your ship's flight systems in one press - the fastest way to get moving after boarding.

label: Cycle camera view
desc: Cycles through your available camera views (first person, third person, etc.).

label: Freelook (Hold)
desc: Hold to look around freely with your head without turning your ship.

label: Precision Targeting - Toggle On / Off
desc: Toggles precision targeting - a steadier, zoomed aiming mode for your ship's weapons.

label: Precision Targeting - Maximum Zoom (hold)
desc: Hold to zoom precision targeting in to its maximum level.

label: Precision Targeting - Toggle Camera Tracking
desc: Toggles whether the camera automatically tracks your locked target while in precision targeting mode.

label: Pitch up
desc: Pitches your ship's nose upward.

label: Pitch down
desc: Pitches your ship's nose downward.

label: Yaw left
desc: Yaws your ship's nose to the left.

label: Yaw right
desc: Yaws your ship's nose to the right.

label: Roll left
desc: Rolls your ship to the left around its forward axis.

label: Roll right
desc: Rolls your ship to the right around its forward axis.

label: Strafe up (abs.)
desc: Thrusts your ship straight up without changing which way it's facing.

label: Strafe down (abs.)
desc: Thrusts your ship straight down without changing which way it's facing.

label: Strafe left (abs.)
desc: Thrusts your ship straight left without changing which way it's facing.

label: Strafe right (abs.)
desc: Thrusts your ship straight right without changing which way it's facing.

label: Throttle - Increase
desc: Increases your ship's forward throttle.

label: Throttle - Decrease
desc: Decreases your ship's forward throttle.

label: Throttle - Cruise Mode - Toggle
desc: Toggles cruise control, which holds your current throttle setting without you needing to keep holding the throttle key.

label: Throttle - Trim - Release (Long Press)
desc: Resets any throttle trim you've applied, returning throttle response to its default center.

label: Throttle - Trim - Release (Short Press)
desc: Resets any throttle trim you've applied, returning throttle response to its default center.

label: Boost
desc: Activates boost, temporarily increasing speed at the cost of extra fuel burn.

label: Speed Limiter - Step Up (tap)
desc: Raises the maximum speed your throttle is capped at, one step at a time.

label: Speed Limiter - Step Down (tap)
desc: Lowers the maximum speed your throttle is capped at, one step at a time.

label: Acceleration Limiter - Step Up (tap)
desc: Raises how aggressively your ship accelerates toward your throttle target, one step at a time.

label: Acceleration Limiter - Step Down (tap)
desc: Lowers how aggressively your ship accelerates toward your throttle target, one step at a time.

label: Spacebrake
desc: Rapidly cuts your ship's velocity to a stop.

label: Landing System (Toggle)
desc: Toggles landing gear and the assisted-landing systems that help you set down safely on a pad.

label: Toggle VTOL
desc: Toggles VTOL mode, which changes how your maneuvering thrusters behave for controlled vertical takeoff and landing.

label: Request Cargo Loading
desc: Requests a cargo elevator or loading dock at your current landing pad.

label: Cycle Master Mode (Long Press)
desc: Switches your ship between its master flight modes - combat (SCM) and cruise (NAV).

label: Auto Targeting - Toggle On/Off (Long Press)
desc: Toggles whether your ship automatically locks onto targets in front of you.

label: Pin Index 1 - Lock / Unlock Pinned Target
desc: Locks or unlocks whichever target is pinned in slot 1.

label: Pin Index 2 - Lock / Unlock Pinned Target
desc: Locks or unlocks whichever target is pinned in slot 2.

label: Pin Index 3 - Lock / Unlock Pinned Target
desc: Locks or unlocks whichever target is pinned in slot 3.

label: Pin Index 1 - Pin / Unpin Selected Target
desc: Pins your currently selected target into slot 1 so you can recall it later, or unpins it.

label: Pin Index 2 - Pin / Unpin Selected Target
desc: Pins your currently selected target into slot 2 so you can recall it later, or unpins it.

label: Pin Index 3 - Pin / Unpin Selected Target
desc: Pins your currently selected target into slot 3 so you can recall it later, or unpins it.

label: Remove All Pinned Targets
desc: Clears every target you currently have pinned.

label: Unlock Current Target
desc: Drops the lock on whatever target you currently have locked.

label: Cycle Lock - In View - Forward
desc: Locks onto the next target visible in front of you.

label: Cycle Lock - In View - Under Reticle
desc: Locks onto whatever target is currently under your reticle.

label: Cycle Lock - Attackers - Forward
desc: Locks onto the next ship that is currently attacking you.

label: Cycle Lock - Attackers - Reset to Closest
desc: Locks onto the closest ship currently attacking you.

label: Cycle Lock - Hostiles - Forward
desc: Locks onto the next hostile target.

label: Cycle Lock - Hostiles - Reset to Closest
desc: Locks onto the closest hostile target.

label: Cycle Lock - Friendlies - Forward
desc: Locks onto the next friendly ship.

label: Cycle Lock - Friendlies - Reset to Closest
desc: Locks onto the closest friendly ship.

label: Cycle Lock - All - Forward
desc: Locks onto the next target regardless of allegiance.

label: Cycle Lock - All - Reset to Closest
desc: Locks onto the closest target regardless of allegiance.

label: Cycle Lock - Sub-Target - Forward
desc: On a target with multiple subsystems (turrets, engines, etc.), locks onto the next subsystem.

label: Cycle Lock - Sub-Target - Reset to Main Target
desc: Clears a subsystem lock and returns your lock to the target's main hull.

label: Fire Mining Laser (Toggle)
desc: Fires your active mining laser at whatever's under your reticle.

label: Switch Mining Laser (Toggle)
desc: Switches which of your equipped mining lasers is active, if you have more than one.

label: Increase Mining Laser Power
desc: Increases the power output of your active mining laser.

label: Jettison Cargo
desc: Dumps cargo out of your ship, including mined material that's become unstable.

label: Salvage Mode Gimbal Reset
desc: Resets your salvage beam's gimbal back to center.

label: Gimbal State - Toggle Locked / Unlocked
desc: Toggles whether your gimbal-mounted weapons swivel freely to track your target, or lock rigidly to the ship's nose.

label: Aim Mode - Cycle
desc: Cycles your weapon aiming assist mode between the options your ship supports (e.g. gimbal, gyro-stabilized, fixed).

label: Weapon Preset - Fire
desc: Fires the weapon group in your currently selected weapon preset.

label: Weapon Presets - Next
desc: Switches to the next saved weapon-group preset.

label: Weapon Presets - Previous
desc: Switches to the previous saved weapon-group preset.

label: Launch Missiles (Tap)
desc: Fires the missile(s) you currently have armed and locked.

label: Cycle Next Missile Type
desc: Switches to the next missile type selected to fire.

label: Cycle Previous Missile Type
desc: Switches to the previous missile type selected to fire.

label: Increase Number of Armed Missiles
desc: Increases how many missiles fire together the next time you launch.

label: Reset Number of Armed Missiles
desc: Resets the number of missiles set to fire together back to one.

label: Toggle Power - All
desc: Turns your ship's main power on or off entirely.

label: Toggle Power - Thrusters
desc: Turns power to your thrusters on or off.

label: Toggle Power - Shields
desc: Turns power to your shields on or off.

label: Toggle Power - Weapons
desc: Turns power to your weapons on or off.

label: Decrease Throttle
desc: Shifts your reactor's overall power output down by one notch.

label: Decrease Throttle to Min
desc: Drops your reactor's overall power output straight to its minimum.

label: Increase Throttle
desc: Shifts your reactor's overall power output up by one notch.

label: Increase Throttle to Max
desc: Raises your reactor's overall power output straight to its maximum.

label: Engines - Increase (Tap)
desc: Shifts one pip of power toward your engines in the power triangle.

label: Engines - Decrease (Tap)
desc: Shifts one pip of power away from your engines in the power triangle.

label: Shields - Increase (Tap)
desc: Shifts one pip of power toward your shields in the power triangle.

label: Shields - Decrease (Tap)
desc: Shifts one pip of power away from your shields in the power triangle.

label: Weapons - Increase (Tap)
desc: Shifts one pip of power toward your weapons in the power triangle.

label: Weapons - Decrease (Tap)
desc: Shifts one pip of power away from your weapons in the power triangle.

label: Reset Assignments
desc: Resets your power triangle back to its default, even balance across engines, shields, and weapons.

label: mobiGlas (Toggle)
desc: Opens or closes your mobiGlas, the wrist-worn device you use for apps like inventory, the starmap, and comms.

label: Scoreboard
desc: Opens the scoreboard showing players in your current game session.

label: Map
desc: Opens the starmap, used for setting quantum travel destinations and viewing the system.

label: Move Left
desc: Moves you left.

label: Move Right
desc: Moves you right.

label: Move Forward
desc: Moves you forward.

label: Move Backwards
desc: Moves you backward.

label: Jump
desc: Jumps.

label: Jump Thrusters - Activate (hold)
desc: Hold to activate your suit's jump thrusters for an extended, controlled jump - most useful in low gravity.

label: Jump Thrusters - Release
desc: Releases a jump-thruster boost you're currently holding.

label: Crouch
desc: Crouches.

label: Prone
desc: Drops you prone, flat on the ground.

label: Sprint
desc: Sprints, moving faster than a normal walk at the cost of stamina.

label: Lean Left
desc: Leans your body left to peek around cover without fully exposing yourself.

label: Lean Right
desc: Leans your body right to peek around cover without fully exposing yourself.

label: Climb Ledges
desc: Grabs and climbs a ledge in front of you.

label: Dodge left
desc: Dodges left - a quick evasive step used in close combat.

label: Dodge Right
desc: Dodges right - a quick evasive step used in close combat.

label: Dodge Back
desc: Dodges back - a quick evasive step used in close combat.

label: Weapon Stance (Toggle)
desc: Toggles between lowering your weapon into a relaxed stance and readying it.

label: Select Primary Weapon
desc: Selects your primary weapon.

label: Select Secondary Weapon
desc: Selects your secondary weapon.

label: Select Sidearm
desc: Selects your sidearm.

label: Select Melee
desc: Selects your melee weapon.

label: Select Gadget
desc: Selects your equipped gadget, such as a tractor beam or multitool.

label: Unarmed Combat
desc: Switches to unarmed, hand-to-hand combat.

label: Reload
desc: Reloads your currently equipped weapon.

label: Reload Secondary Fire
desc: Reloads your weapon's secondary fire mode - for example an underslung attachment - separately from its main magazine.

label: Repool Ammunition
desc: Pools spare ammo from your inventory back into usable magazines for your current weapon.

label: Holster Weapon
desc: Holsters your weapon.

label: Customize Weapon
desc: Opens the attachment customization screen for your currently held weapon.

label: Hold Breath (ADS)
desc: Holds your breath while aiming down sights, steadying your aim for a short time.

label: FPS Underbarrel Attachment Action
desc: Triggers an underbarrel attachment's action, such as firing an underslung grenade launcher.

label: Change Fire Mode
desc: Cycles your weapon's fire mode - for example single, burst, or automatic.

label: Request Rescue (while Incapacitated)
desc: While incapacitated, signals nearby players that you need reviving.

label: Flashlight (Toggle)
desc: Toggles your suit's flashlight.

label: Toggle Equip Helmet
desc: Puts on or removes your helmet.

label: Third Person View (Toggle)
desc: Switches between first-person and third-person camera view.

label: mobiGlas (Toggle)
desc: Opens or closes your mobiGlas, the wrist-worn device you use for apps like inventory, the starmap, and comms.

label: Scoreboard
desc: Opens the scoreboard showing players in your current game session.

label: Map
desc: Opens the starmap, used for setting quantum travel destinations and viewing the system.

label: Force Re-spawn (E.V.A. / On Foot)
desc: Hold to force an immediate respawn if you're stuck, rather than waiting.

label: Regen (while Incapacitated)
desc: While incapacitated, hold to give up and respawn instead of waiting to be revived.

label: Forward
desc: Plays the 'forward' quick gesture from the communication wheel, without opening the full emote menu.

label: Left
desc: Plays the 'left' quick gesture from the communication wheel, without opening the full emote menu.

label: Right
desc: Plays the 'right' quick gesture from the communication wheel, without opening the full emote menu.

label: Stop
desc: Plays the 'stop' quick gesture from the communication wheel, without opening the full emote menu.

label: Yes
desc: Plays the 'yes' quick gesture from the communication wheel, without opening the full emote menu.

label: No
desc: Plays the 'no' quick gesture from the communication wheel, without opening the full emote menu.

label: Roll Left
desc: Rolls your body left while moving in zero-g EVA.

label: Roll Right
desc: Rolls your body right while moving in zero-g EVA.

label: Strafe Up
desc: Thrusts you upward while moving in zero-g EVA.

label: Strafe Down
desc: Thrusts you downward while moving in zero-g EVA.

label: Strafe Left
desc: Thrusts you left while moving in zero-g EVA.

label: Strafe Right
desc: Thrusts you right while moving in zero-g EVA.

label: Strafe Forward
desc: Thrusts you forward while moving in zero-g EVA.

label: Strafe Backward
desc: Thrusts you backward while moving in zero-g EVA.

label: Brake
desc: Cancels your current EVA momentum, bringing you to a stop.

label: Boost
desc: Boosts your EVA movement speed, at the cost of more propellant.

label: Freelook (Hold)
desc: Hold to look around freely with your head without changing your EVA movement direction.

label: Horn
desc: Honks the vehicle's horn.

label: Cycle camera view
desc: Cycles through your available camera views (first person, third person, etc.).

label: Freelook (Hold)
desc: Hold to look around freely with your head without turning your ship.

label: mobiGlas (Toggle)
desc: Opens or closes your mobiGlas, the wrist-worn device you use for apps like inventory, the starmap, and comms.

label: Flight / Systems Ready
desc: Powers up and readies all your ship's flight systems in one press - the fastest way to get moving after boarding.

label: Map
desc: Opens the starmap, used for setting quantum travel destinations and viewing the system.

label: Drive Forward
desc: Drives the vehicle forward.

label: Drive Backward
desc: Drives the vehicle backward.

label: Turn Left
desc: Turns the vehicle left.

label: Turn Right
desc: Turns the vehicle right.

label: Brake
desc: Applies the vehicle's brakes.

label: Boost
desc: Activates the vehicle's boost.

label: Toggle Auto Braking On Idle
desc: Toggles whether the vehicle automatically brakes when you let off the throttle.

label: Spectator Camera Lock Target
desc: Locks the spectator camera onto a target.

label: Spectator Camera HUD (Toggle)
desc: Toggles the HUD while spectating.

label: Spectator Camera Mode (Next)
desc: Switches to the next spectator camera mode.

label: Re-spawn
desc: Respawns your character.

label: Exit seat
desc: Gets you out of your current seat.

label: Notifications - Accept Prompt
desc: Accepts the notification currently on screen.

label: Notifications - Decline Prompt
desc: Declines the notification currently on screen.

label: CommLink App (Toggle)
desc: Opens or closes the CommLink contacts app.

label: Chat Window (Toggle)
desc: Opens or closes the text chat window.

label: Accept Invite
desc: Accepts an incoming party or group invite.

label: Reject Invite
desc: Declines an incoming party or group invite.

label: VOIP Push To Talk
desc: Hold to transmit your voice over chat.

label: VOIP Push To Talk (Proximity only)
desc: Hold to transmit your voice to nearby players only, regardless of party chat.

label: FOIP Selfie Cam
desc: Hold to briefly switch the camera to your own character's face - useful for checking your FOIP face tracking.

label: FOIP Recalibrate
desc: Recalibrates FOIP face tracking to your neutral expression.

label: Cycle through audio channels
desc: Cycles which voice channel you're listening to or transmitting on.

desc: Holds to bring up the Inner Thought interaction wheel for whatever you're looking at.

category: Quick Keys, Interactions, and Inner Thought
label: Toogle Loot Screen (hold)

category: Quick Keys, Interactions, and Inner Thought
label: Toggle Looting View
desc: Switches between the different inventory layout views while looting.

label: Mining Mode Actions - PIT Category

category: Quick Keys, Interactions, and Inner Thought

desc: Holds to open a radial quick-select menu for your sidearm loadout.

category: Quick Keys, Interactions, and Inner Thought
label: Throwable Select Radial Menu
desc: Holds to open a radial quick-select menu for your throwables.

category: Quick Keys, Interactions, and Inner Thought
label: Consumable Select Radial Menu
desc: Holds to open a radial quick-select menu for your consumables - food, drink, and meds.

label: Clear Saved View
desc: Clears a saved camera view slot.

label: X Offset Positive
desc: Moves the camera's focus point along the X axis while in Advanced Camera Controls.

label: X Offset Negative
desc: Moves the camera's focus point along the X axis, in reverse, while in Advanced Camera Controls.

label: Y Offset Positive / Spectator Freecam Focal Point Forward
desc: Moves the camera's focus point along the Y axis while in Advanced Camera Controls.

label: Y Offset Negative / Spectator Freecam Focal Point Backward
desc: Moves the camera's focus point along the Y axis, in reverse, while in Advanced Camera Controls.

label: Z Offset Positive
desc: Moves the camera's focus point along the Z axis while in Advanced Camera Controls.

label: Z Offset Negative
desc: Moves the camera's focus point along the Z axis, in reverse, while in Advanced Camera Controls.

desc: Increases the camera's field of view.

label: Decrease FoV
desc: Decreases the camera's field of view.

label: Decrease DoF
